title: Headphones with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Headband -->
  <path d='M20 55 Q20 15 50 15 Q80 15 80 55' fill='none' stroke='#8e6bd8' stroke-width='9' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Headband highlight -->
  <path d='M26 50 Q26 22 50 22 Q74 22 74 50' fill='none' stroke='#b79bf0' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Left ear cup outer -->
  <rect x='11' y='48' width='22' height='30' rx='10' fill='#5d3fa8'/>
  <!-- Left ear cup inner pad -->
  <rect x='16' y='53' width='12' height='20' rx='6' fill='#8e6bd8'/>
  <!-- Right ear cup outer -->
  <rect x='67' y='48' width='22' height='30' rx='10' fill='#5d3fa8'/>
  <!-- Right ear cup inner pad -->
  <rect x='72' y='53' width='12' height='20' rx='6' fill='#8e6bd8'/>
  <!-- Face plate -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='62' r='22' fill='#ffcf6e'/>
  <!-- Face plate lighter rim -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='62' r='22' fill='none' stroke='#ffe6a8' stroke-width='3'/>
  <!-- Left eye -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='57' r='4' fill='#7a4b12'/>
  <circle cx='43.5' cy='55.5' r='1.4' fill='#fff6dd'/>
  <!-- Right eye -->
  <circle cx='58' cy='57' r='4' fill='#7a4b12'/>
  <circle cx='59.5' cy='55.5' r='1.4' fill='#fff6dd'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M40 68 Q50 78 60 68' fill='none' stroke='#7a4b12' stroke-width='3.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='66' r='3' fill='#ff9e7a'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='66' r='3' fill='#ff9e7a'/>
  <!-- Cable -->
  <path d='M22 78 Q22 90 40 90' fill='none' stroke='#c9a7ff' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Cable plug -->
  <rect x='40' y='86' width='9' height='8' rx='2' fill='#8e6bd8'/>
</svg>
